nodes.label: AutoVideo
nodes.rationale: Markdown teaching scripts compiled to MP4; CLI complete, Web UI in progress

nodes.label: Web UI Agent Workflow
nodes.rationale: Read WEB_PROGRESS then WEB_TASKS, mark in_progress, implement, accept, commit, mark done — one task per run

nodes.label: ETag Optimistic Concurrency
nodes.rationale: GET returns ETag sha256; PUT requires If-Match; conflict returns 409

nodes.label: Single-Thread FIFO Task Queue
nodes.rationale: Only one task runs at a time; Web mode does not read ~/.claude/settings.json

nodes.label: Build Output Path Constraint
nodes.rationale: All build artifacts must live under project/{name}/build/{slug}/

nodes.label: Deepread Authoring Principles
nodes.rationale: Explain tech only, never restate video; leave empty if no technical depth; each block file is self-contained

nodes.label: .autovideo-web Config Store
nodes.rationale: UI settings and API keys in .autovideo-web/config.json; must stay gitignored

nodes.label: Branded Stage Readiness Types
nodes.rationale: CompiledScript → AudioReadyScript → VisualReadyScript → RenderInputScript → RenderedScript enforce stage order at compile time

nodes.label: Subtitle Line Length Limit
nodes.rationale: Chinese ≤50 chars / English ≤70 to avoid multi-line subtitle crowding the visual

nodes.label: Build --out Directory Rule
nodes.rationale: Always pass --out $PROJECT_DIR/build/<slug>; omitting --out pollutes repo-root build/

nodes.label: CLI Design Principles
nodes.rationale: AI only where needed (visuals); single IR; per-stage/per-block rerun; fail loud; local-first; previewable

nodes.label: Per-Block Partial Render
nodes.rationale: Each block renders to partials/B**.mp4 then ffmpeg concat; single-block edit cost ≈ one remotion + concat

nodes.label: voiceRef Zero-Shot Timbre
nodes.rationale: Single reference WAV is the only timbre mechanism for the whole video

nodes.label: Deepread Priority Tiers
nodes.rationale: P0 ~60 flagship hard blocks first; high-reuse glossary cards before full coverage

nodes.label: Portfolio Deepread Site
nodes.rationale: Video is entry; sentence-synced transcript + block deepread is the product; separate from web/ authoring tool

nodes.label: Synced vs Authored Data Split
nodes.rationale: Synced layer rebuilds from project/; authored deepread never touched by pipeline; orphans never auto-deleted

nodes.label: Compile Source Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Only compile/build snapshot source into build/{slug}/_snapshot/ including voice/; downstream stages read script.json only

nodes.label: Single script.md Constraint
nodes.rationale: v1 forces project.json blocks:["./script.md"]; non-standard projects are read-only with banner

nodes.label: MuseTalk Integration Pipeline
nodes.rationale: After concat: extract audio → MuseTalk → rounded PiP overlay → loudnorm/QA

nodes.label: Third-party self-hosted HTTP services
nodes.rationale: AutoVideo connects only via endpoints; it does not install or start the services.

nodes.label: Ubuntu 22.04 + NVIDIA GPU target environment
nodes.rationale: T2I and lipsync need GPU; TTS can run on CPU.

nodes.label: torch.load weights_only=False patch
nodes.rationale: PyTorch ≥ 2.6 defaults weights_only=True, breaking old mmpose/mmengine checkpoints; patch before importing musetalk.

nodes.label: Serial inference lock
nodes.rationale: Thread lock serializes inference to match AutoVideo single-task FIFO.

nodes.label: max-avatar-seconds avatar trim
nodes.rationale: Default trim to 15s avoids long face-detection cost on mis-uploaded long videos; aligns with few-second loop avatars.

nodes.label: float16 VRAM savings
nodes.rationale: float16 ~8–10GB vs float32 ~14–16GB; recommended on RTX 5090.

nodes.label: Avatar PiP lipsync mode
nodes.rationale: Needed only when meta has avatarRef and skipLipsync is not true.

nodes.label: Lipsync response without audio track
nodes.rationale: Server strips audio so the main pipeline can remux narration onto the final cut.

nodes.label: @visual image mode
nodes.rationale: Only needed for @visual image blocks; @visual animation uses Claude-generated components instead.

nodes.label: Futuristic Tech Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: Dark void background with blue emissive geometry, particle sparks, and motion streaks convey advanced computation / Unreal-style tech build theme for a video thumbnail.
